decisions.title: West Central Complete Streets Frequently Asked Questions
decisions.description: Explains the project scope, anticipated 2027 construction, funding, walking and bicycling facilities, drainage and intersection work, property and business access, possible speed-limit changes, transit coordination, and the 2026 public-feedback process.
processing_notes: Original authoritative PDF preserved without modification after text extraction and representative-page visual review.
The July 24, 2026 comment deadline is historical and is not presented as an active opportunity on ABQInfo.

decisions.title: West Central Complete Streets 60% Design Roll Plot
decisions.description: Maps the draft 60-percent corridor design from Sarracino Place to 98th Street, documenting frontage-road reconstruction, walking and bicycling facilities, drainage, lighting, intersection geometry, access changes, and other proposed improvements.
processing_notes: Original authoritative one-sheet PDF preserved without modification after text extraction and full-page visual review.
The drawing is explicitly labeled preliminary and subject to change.

decisions.title: West Central Complete Streets Open House Boards
decisions.description: Presents the project area, purpose, proposed cross-sections, protected-intersection design at 98th Street, Bridge Boulevard changes, drainage, lighting, access, multimodal improvements, funding, schedule, and public-input material shown in 2026.
processing_notes: Original authoritative seven-page PDF preserved without modification after text extraction and representative-page visual review.

decisions.title: Dr. MLK Separated Bike Lane Pilot Project FAQ in Spanish
decisions.description: Provides the City’s Spanish-language explanation of the pilot limits, safety basis, separation materials, intersection treatments, maintenance evaluation, ridership data, community feedback, and relationship to Vision Zero and adopted bicycle priorities.
processing_notes: Original authoritative Spanish-language PDF preserved without modification after text extraction and representative-page visual review.
